outputs.L1: The present invention aims to provide a precision filter suitable for filtering process liquids used in circuit board production, exhibiting exceptional resistance to both strongly acidic and strongly alkaline cleaning liquids and an exceptional ability to remove extremely fine foreign substances. The present invention also aims to provide a precision filter cartridge for use with circuit board production process liquids that incorporates the precision filter. A further objective is to provide a method for producing a circuit board using a process liquid filtered through either the precision filter or the precision filter cartridge. The precision filter according to the present invention, which is configured to filter a process liquid used in circuit board production, is characterized by comprising a tetrafluoroethylene copolymer (I) having an amino group in a side chain.
outputs.L2: The invention aims to provide a high-precision filter for liquids used in circuit-board manufacturing. The filter offers exceptional resistance to both highly acidic and highly alkaline cleaning solutions and is highly effective at capturing ultrafine contaminants. Another aim is to provide a filter cartridge that incorporates this precision filter for use with circuit-board processing liquids. A further aim is to establish a method of manufacturing a circuit board using a process liquid purified by either the precision filter or the corresponding filter cartridge. The precision filter of the invention is distinguished by including a tetrafluoroethylene copolymer (I) bearing an amino group on a side chain.
outputs.L3:
The invention provides a precision filter specifically suited to filtering liquids used in circuit board production processes. The filter exhibits excellent chemical resistance to strongly acidic and strongly alkaline cleaning liquids, making it suitable for use under demanding process conditions. It is also highly effective at removing extremely fine foreign substances, thereby helping to maintain the purity of process liquids and improve manufacturing reliability.

The invention further provides a precision filter cartridge incorporating the filter, as well as a method for producing circuit boards using a process liquid filtered through the cartridge. The precision filter comprises a tetrafluoroethylene copolymer having an amino group in a side chain. This composition provides the filter with the chemical durability and fine-particle removal capability required for circuit board production.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to a precision filter, a filter cartridge incorporating the filter, and a method for producing circuit boards using a process liquid purified by the filter. The filter contains a tetrafluoroethylene copolymer having amino groups in its side chains. By combining the chemical durability of a fluoropolymer backbone with the contaminant-capturing properties provided by the amino-functional side chains, the filter can be used under the severe chemical conditions encountered in circuit-board manufacturing.

The filter exhibits excellent resistance to both strongly acidic and strongly alkaline liquids, including cleaning, washing, etching, developing, stripping, and related process solutions. It maintains its structural integrity and filtration performance even when repeatedly or continuously exposed to such liquids. At the same time, the amino-functional copolymer enables the filter to capture and remove extremely fine contaminants that may be difficult to eliminate using conventional chemically resistant filters. These contaminants may include fine particles, residues, precipitates, and other impurities capable of adhering to or damaging a circuit-board surface.

The filter may be formed as a porous filtration medium and installed in a cartridge suitable for connection to a process-liquid supply or circulation line. The resulting filter cartridge can be used to purify fresh process liquid before use, to continuously filter liquid in a processing bath, or to filter recovered liquid before reuse. The cartridge configuration facilitates handling, replacement, and integration into existing circuit-board production equipment while limiting contamination during maintenance.

In the circuit-board production method, a process liquid is passed through the filter cartridge and the resulting filtered liquid is brought into contact with a circuit board or circuit-board substrate. Filtration may be performed before or during cleaning and other wet-processing operations. Removing very fine contaminants reduces particle deposition, surface defects, pattern irregularities, and contamination-related failures. Consequently, the invention improves process stability, product yield, and the reliability of manufactured circuit boards while permitting the use of filtration equipment in highly acidic and highly alkaline environments.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for an invention involving a precision filter made from a tetrafluoroethylene copolymer with amino side groups, designed to filter strongly acidic and alkaline liquids used in circuit board manufacturing.
counterfactuals.output: A precision filtration device is provided for filtering strongly acidic or strongly alkaline process liquids used in circuit board manufacturing. The device includes a porous filter medium formed from a tetrafluoroethylene copolymer having amino-functional side groups. The fluorinated copolymer provides chemical and thermal resistance, while the amino-functional side groups improve liquid wettability and promote retention of fine particles and selected ionic or colloidal contaminants. The filter medium may be configured as a membrane, hollow fiber, sheet, pleated element, or cartridge and may have a controlled pore-size distribution selected for microfiltration or ultrafiltration. The device is suitable for treating etching solutions, cleaning solutions, plating baths, stripping liquids, and related process chemicals over a broad pH range. The filter reduces particulate contamination without substantial degradation, swelling, or extractable release, thereby improving process-liquid purity, circuit pattern uniformity, and manufacturing yield. Methods of manufacturing the filter medium and filtering circuit board process liquids using the device are also provided.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe the objectives and key distinguishing feature of a precision filter, filter cartridge, and filtration-based method for producing circuit boards.
counterfactuals.output:
- **Precision filter objective:** Purify process liquids used in circuit-board manufacture—such as plating, developing, etching, or cleaning solutions—by removing very fine suspended particles that could cause shorts, opens, pinholes, rough plating, or other defects.

- **Filter-cartridge objective:** Provide a replaceable, high-capacity element that captures contaminants efficiently while maintaining stable flow, low pressure loss, and avoiding secondary contamination.

- **Filtration-method objective:** Continuously or cyclically pass the production liquid through the filter so that particle levels remain controlled and the solution can be reused, improving board yield and extending bath life.

**Key distinguishing feature:** a **graded, multilayer precision-filtration cartridge**, generally arranged from coarser upstream media to finer downstream media. This depth-filtration structure traps larger particles first and progressively captures micron-scale contaminants, giving both high filtration accuracy and a longer service life than a single, uniform filter layer.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a formal patent summary for a chemical-resistant precision filter capable of removing extremely fine contaminants from circuit board production process liquids.
counterfactuals.output:
A chemical-resistant precision filtration apparatus is disclosed for removing submicron particulate and colloidal contaminants from process liquids used in circuit board manufacturing. The apparatus includes a chemically inert housing defining an inlet, a filtrate outlet, and a filtration chamber containing a replaceable filter element. The filter element comprises a microporous or nanoporous membrane supported by a rigid porous substrate and sealed within the housing to prevent liquid bypass. Liquid-contacting components may be formed from fluoropolymers or other materials resistant to acidic, alkaline, oxidizing, and solvent-containing process liquids.

The filter element may have a pleated, tubular, hollow-fiber, or multilayer configuration and may include a graded prefiltration layer upstream of the membrane. A flow-distribution structure directs process liquid substantially uniformly across the membrane, reducing localized fouling and maintaining filtration accuracy. The apparatus may operate in dead-end or cross-flow mode and may include provisions for venting, draining, flushing, integrity testing, and differential-pressure monitoring.

The disclosed apparatus is suitable for filtration of plating baths, etchants, cleaning solutions, developing solutions, stripping liquids, rinsing liquids, and related circuit board production fluids. By combining chemically resistant wetted surfaces, bypass-resistant sealing, and a high-retention membrane, the apparatus reduces fine particulate contamination that can cause circuit defects while limiting extractables, metal-ion contamination, and degradation of the process liquid.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3
